createRoleDescription: Set a name and level for the custom role. Its level must be below yours ({level}); higher levels grant broader access.
editRoleDescription: Change the role name and level. Its level must be below yours ({level}); higher levels grant broader access.
roleDetailDescription: Higher levels grant broader access. Built-in roles are protected and cannot be changed.
roleProtected: Built-in roles and roles at or above your level cannot be changed.
deleteRoleDescription: A role cannot be deleted while it is assigned to active users. Once deleted, it will no longer be available for assignment.
discardRoleDescription: Unsaved role name, level, or assignment changes will be lost.
errorInvalidRole: Role names can contain lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens. The level must be a positive whole number below your own.
